title.zh: 月之暗面（Kimi）完成IPO前最终一轮融资，估值约500亿美元
title.en: 月之暗面（Kimi）完成IPO前最终一轮融资，估值约500亿美元

current_state.zh: Moonshot AI (Kimi) has closed its final pre-IPO private funding round at a valuation of about $50 billion and is preparing a Hong Kong IPO targeted for the first quarter of next year, with early investor discussions potentially beginning this month.
